description: This file defines the Image_Canvas class, which handles creation of images in various formats and output options, including drawing shapes, text, images, and managing canvas properties. It also includes a factory method for creating specific canvas format instances.

classes.name: Image_Canvas
classes.description: A class for handling different output formats for image creation, including drawing primitives, text, images, and managing canvas properties.

methods.name: Image_Canvas
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the canvas with given parameters such as width, height, left, and top offsets.

methods.name: setLineThickness
methods.description: Sets the thickness of lines to be drawn.

methods.name: setLineColor
methods.description: Sets the color of lines to be drawn.

methods.name: setFill
methods.description: Sets the fill style, which can be a color, image, or gradient.

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color for shapes.

methods.name: setFillImage
methods.description: Sets an image for filling shapes (method not implemented).

methods.name: setGradientFill
methods.description: Sets a gradient fill style.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Configures font options including name, size, angle, and file mapping.

methods.name: setDefaultFont
methods.description: Sets the default font options.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets fill style, line style, thickness, polygon vertices, and font to default states.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Public method to reset the canvas.

methods.name: drawEnd
methods.description: Draws a line end (not implemented).

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with optional end styles.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to a polygon with optional link and map info.

methods.name: addSpline
methods.description: Adds a spline vertex to a polygon with control points.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon (not implemented).

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle shape (not implemented).

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse shape (not implemented).

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice shape (not implemented).

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a text string (not implemented).

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of a text string (not implemented).

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text to the canvas (resets style afterward).

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image onto the canvas (not implemented).

methods.name: setClipping
methods.description: Sets a clipping region (not implemented).

methods.name: startGroup
methods.description: Starts a new drawing group (not implemented).

methods.name: endGroup
methods.description: Ends the current drawing group (not implemented).

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the canvas to the browser, setting no-cache headers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the canvas output to a file (not implemented).

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Outputs the canvas as an HTML tag, saving the image and providing URL.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Factory method to create specific canvas format instances based on type (png, jpg, pdf, svg, imagemap).
